description: July 20 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 3, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 20 birthday falls in Cancer, in the third decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: July 20 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The 20th of July sits in Cancer's late degrees, twenty-seven along, with Neptune shading the decan and 2 as the birthday number. Partnership and empathy are the themes interpretive traditions emphasise: an intuitive listener, a loyal companion, a peacemaker in families. Sensitivity runs high, so this birthday often does best in calm, emotionally honest company.

On July 20 the Sun usually sits at about 27° Cancer, in the third decan, where Neptune is the sub-ruler alongside Moon. Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces, shapes the final decan of Cancer, from about July 13 to July 22. Here the sign's sensitivity widens into something more porous and imaginative. Those born in this stretch are often described as dreamy, compassionate and highly attuned to atmosphere, art and music. They may absorb other people's feelings without noticing where their own end. Neptune can bring a gift for healing spaces, storytelling and quiet kindness, along with a tendency to retreat when life gets loud. Clear boundaries, gently held, tend to protect that compassion rather than limit it.

sections.heading: July 20 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one July 20 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on July 20: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 20 is the 201st day of the year (202nd in a leap year). By July 23, 3 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Leo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 20, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on July 20 include Edmund Hillary (1919), Gregor Mendel (1822) and Gisele Bündchen (1980).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 20?
faq.answer: July 20 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 20 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 20?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 20 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 20?
faq.answer: July 20 is also the birthday of Edmund Hillary (1919), Gregor Mendel (1822) and Gisele Bündchen (1980). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
